This is my add on opinion that I just want you guys know, my rating all came from the above problem
Another problem about the UX is about the page spliting. Now this note is uni-body note but what I want about it for the last 3 years of owning this is just some kinds of page indicator so that my note won't be cut through whenever I convert it to PDF (if you guys can make different type of grids, why don't you guys add page indicator that can be turned on and off like the grid?).
